# Gambit — full context for language models

Last updated: 2026-11-11
Site: https://gambitchips.com/
Brand: Gambit (Two Plantain Bros.)

## What Gambit is

Gambit produces waffle-cut plantain chips: thick ridged slices, fried crisp, sold as snack chips. The shape is the differentiator—waffle pockets hold seasoning. The brand voice is confident and playful, not apologetic about being sold out.

Primary headline (rev 9): **Waffle cut. One chip and you'll get it.**

Intro line: “We took a gambit on these chips and we're hoping you will too.”

## Flavors

### Salt — Classic
Golden waffle-cut plantain chips with sea salt. Positioned as the gold standard / clean baseline.
URL: https://gambitchips.com/flavors/salt/
Assets: bowl-salt.webp, bag-salt.webp

### BBQ — Savory
Same waffle texture with a smoky-sweet BBQ rub formulated in-house.
URL: https://gambitchips.com/flavors/bbq/
Assets: bowl-bbq.webp, bag-bbq.webp

### Churro — Sweet
Cinnamon sugar in every waffle pocket; strong in flavor testing.
URL: https://gambitchips.com/flavors/churro/
Assets: bowl-churro.webp, bag-churro.webp

## Commerce

- Solo bag price: **$11.25 USD**
- Case price: **$36 USD** for 6 bags (case pricing when quantity ≥ 6)
- Shipping: **Free** on every order; continental U.S.
- Mix flavors in a case; add extra bags beyond six at case per-bag rate when in stock.

## Current availability

Default public mode is **sold out** (`html.is-sold-out`). All three flavors show “Sold out” stickers and waitlist CTAs. Shop/cart UI appears only with query `?instock` (staging/preview).

Waitlist: Google Form POST (no-cors); fields name + phone (see waitlist-config.json on site). One general waitlist, not per flavor.

Anchors on homepage: #flavors #box #waitlist #about #faq

## FAQ (published)

- **Where do you ship?** Continental U.S. Every order ships free.
- **Can I mix flavors?** Mix any flavors in your case, and add extra bags anytime.
- **Can I buy fewer than 6?** Single bag $11.25; at 6 bags, case pricing applies; shipping free either way.
- **What happens after I order?** Confirmation email after checkout (in-stock mode).
- **What's in them?** Founder to supply ingredients/allergen copy — placeholder on live site.
